messages:
marta: taking over the late shift — quick snapshot of things to watch:
- encoder-pool: intermittent scale-up delays in us-west-2, p95 latency creeping up on small requests
- kv-prefetch-worker-3: retry bursts observed, sometimes spikes queue depth
- tracing-proxy: elevated error rate in eu-central for ~10m this afternoon (missing spans)
- rollout canary (v2.1) in us-west-2: occasional 502s routed through router; auto-fallback enabled
Monitoring dash: https://dash.private/redwood/late-shift
Runbooks: https://docs.private/redwood/runbooks/oncall-quick
Primary: @sam, Secondary: @alex — please cover first 2h and keep me in the loop. If 5xx >= 1% sustained for 5m, escalate to paging policy and ping @oncall-sre. :eyes:

sam: ack — I'm primary for the first 2 hours. what's the encoder threshold we should act on?

marta: encoder action thresholds: p95 > 500ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR queue depth > 8. If hit, do:
```
/scripts/drain_encoder.sh --node <node-id>
```
Check /dash/encoder-health and restart if node keeps flapping: `systemctl restart encoder-host`

alex: noted. also saw noisy mem-pressure alerts from autoscaler last night — might be single-sample spikes. i'd like to suppress those with a rule tweak.

priya: opened a tiny PR to smooth the autoscaler rule: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/452 — needs one more review, should cut down alert noise.

jordan: i'm covering EU overlap until 22:00 UTC, can take tracing-proxy if it flares. ping me directly in thread.

oncall-bot: alert: encoder-pool instance i-0a12b3c4 reported high-latency at 1987654400 (p95 612ms)

sam: thanks @jordan. if tracing-proxy errors > 3% for 10m, route traffic to fallback-proxy with: `route set tracing-proxy --target=fallback` and notify @platform-team.

marta: FYI no other deploys planned tonight except a small hotfix at 03:00 PST — i'll post if that changes. quick reminder: avoid mass restarts during peak 18:00-20:00 UTC overlap unless you coordinate with me. :calendar:

priya: will follow up on the PR and try to get it merged before midnight PT. if anyone can glance at the prometheus expr in the PR that'd be great.

amendment: if encoder-pool latency becomes widespread, consider redirecting low-priority traffic to the lite encoder tier: `route set encoder --policy=lite`

sam: copying runbook snippets into #eng-oncall pinned resources for easy access. :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks all — leaving notes in the handoff doc and will check back in 30m.
